parameters.content:
## Content Creation Agent
**Two entry points:** the form (standalone) or the Orchestrator (Execute Workflow).

1. Gemini writes blog articles, social posts (Facebook / Instagram / TikTok / Snapchat), ad copy (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Google Ads) and landing page copy, using Google Search for trends.
2. If "Visuals" is ticked, Gemini (Nano Banana) generates up to 3 images.
3. Everything is packed into a downloadable HTML file with Copy buttons.

Nothing is published from here - publishing happens in the **Social Media Agent** after your approval.
